data_decision.reason: The official classes are numerically balanced; errors are concentrated in class-15/class-13 semantic neighbors, background false positives, and public-domain shift.
data_decision.adjustment: Keep official data read-only; balance public class-10 contribution for an expert experiment and add class-13/class-15 hard-negative images without touching the frozen official validation split.

final_decision: Keep the 16-class official-plus-public model in production. The two-class expert is retained as an experiment; it does not yet beat the frozen official class-10 baseline and must not replace or gate production automatically.
next_step: Calibrate class-specific thresholds and test a crop-level expert re-ranker on official validation, then add real field samples for classes 8 and 10 before another full retrain.
